newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso drops as banks build up positions.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso drops as banks build up positions.

text.p: Colombia's peso dropped back 2.8 against the greenback to end the week at 1,070.8 amid light demand from banks looking to build up dollar positions, interbank traders said.

Some banks started the morning selling dollars, anticipating a rise in the value of the local currency, but realized the movement was not going to be as strong as expected and stepped in to buy back greenbacks.
Traders reported 370 operations worth a total $154 million. The peso opened at 1,064.2 and hit an intraday high of 1,063 before closing at the day's low.
